method: For each of the 396 captured Module 1 quiz questions, key + stem terms BM25-scored against 90-second windows of every captioned video on the Dr Matt & Dr Mike channel (691 of 708 tracks, pulled 2026-09-06). Top candidates judged from the caption text by Gemini Flash (OpenRouter), every 'yes' carrying a 6-15 word verbatim quote that was then re-found mechanically in the track (all exact or >=85% fuzzy); `at` is that position minus 3 s. Claude re-read 105 of the 193 accepted matches (every multi-part question, every video outside the keyword shortlist, every low-coverage or short-quote case, plus every tenth of the rest) and struck none. Captions are not shipped. Questions absent from `matches` have no video whose captions teach them. Re-keyed to hs2-paper-m1's question ids by remap-video-matches.mjs (112 joined on the exact stem, 14 on stem + quiz, 0 on token overlap after the capture adapter removed embedded-player text from the stem); the match lists themselves are unchanged. | 2026-09-07 rescue pass (top-8 over unmatched, Flash-judged, quote-gated + refuted). | 2026-09-07 Ninja Nerd gap-fill (top-8 over the still-unmatched, Flash-judged, quote-gated + refuted). | 2026-09-07 gap-fill from AnatomyZone/IHA/Armando (top-8 over the still-unmatched, Flash-judged, quote-gated + refuted, judged clip end).
